sections.title: Return to the same place
sections.body:
The first visit gives us a view. The second gives us a comparison. By the fifth visit, we have begun to notice how much the first view left out.

A shoreline does not present one stable object. The tide changes, the light changes, and the observer learns to ask different questions.

sections.title: Keep the ordinary observations
sections.body: A notebook full of remarkable events is a poor account of an ordinary month. Record the calm days, the empty quadrats, and the instruments that did not behave as expected. These observations provide the context that a spectacular result needs.

sections.title: Say what the record cannot tell us
sections.body: Our demonstration survey describes one fictional reach of coast. It cannot establish a regional trend. A useful account makes that limitation visible before a reader mistakes detail for generality.

pages.summary: Reusable layouts, metrics, charts, collections, and interaction contracts within each design language.

sections.title: One language, demanding applications
sections.body: The dashboard frame composes the existing source shell, native buttons, table and form styles, disclosures, status regions, and independent family tokens. The sidebar and bounded working area are an application composition, not a separate design system.

sections.title: Metrics and chart frames
sections.body: Metric values name their unit and comparison basis. Chart frames pair labelled SVGs with exact data tables. These capabilities have no chart-library dependency and load only on dashboard pages.

sections.title: Portable behaviour
sections.body: Date filtering, aggregation, collection sorting and pagination, validation, bulk updates, thresholds, and acknowledgement rules live in framework-neutral modules. Both families use the same modules and synthetic fixture. Browser-local changes reset on reload.

sections.title: Design authorities
sections.body: Jameshoward.us remains authoritative for Martlet; krigsvold.org remains authoritative for Krigsvold. The application layout extends the language to a working context while preserving source controls, typography, palette roles, and navigation identity.
